projects.name: Job Search CRM & AI Application Tailoring Center
bullets: Deployed job-search platform (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Oracle Cloud VM) with LLM resume tailoring checked by a non-LLM guardrail, a ReAct research agent, a Chrome extension that fills applications on 7 applicant-tracking systems, and 1,100+ automated tests.
Deployed Platform: FastAPI and Jinja2 application on an Oracle Cloud VM behind Caddy HTTPS, backed by Supabase PostgreSQL with row-level security on every table and Alembic migrations.

Guarded AI Tailoring: Tailors resumes and cover letters with Claude (provider-agnostic, with Gemini and Ollama as alternates), checked by a non-LLM guardrail that blocks any skill or claim not in the master profile, plus a ReAct research agent with tool-calling over the app's own data.

Application Autofill Extension: Chrome extension that fills applications on 7 applicant-tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Recruitee, Personio, Workable, SmartRecruiters), including Shadow DOM forms, file attachment and honeypot-field detection; nothing is ever submitted without a human click.

Cost-Controlled Intake: Ingests postings from direct ATS boards and remote job boards, runs free mechanical scoring before any paid LLM call, and enforces a daily LLM spend cap; resumes render to PDF with ReportLab and page-count check.

Tested and Operated in Production: 1,100+ pytest tests in a GitHub Actions CI pipeline; traced a database egress-quota breach to a dedup query fetching full job descriptions, and removed a ~90-second deploy outage caused by a blocking scheduler shutdown.

projects.name: Job Market Lakehouse
bullets: PySpark and Scala Spark SQL over 60,000 synthetic job postings, with Great Expectations gating the output and an Airflow DAG running the whole pipeline end to end.

PySpark Transformation Pipeline: Built PySpark job over 60k synthetic postings -- a join, a groupBy/agg salary-stats aggregation, and a dense_rank() window function ranking postings within each industry.
Scala Spark Job: Wrote a complementary Scala Spark SQL job (monthly posting-volume-by-source aggregation), run via spark-shell against Spark distribution.
Data Quality Gating: Wrote 11 Great Expectations checks (row counts, categorical sets, uniqueness, a cross-column comparison) validating the PySpark output.

Pipeline Orchestration: Built Airflow DAG (generate -> transform -> validate) verified end-to-end via `airflow dags test` -- fixed pydantic/typing_extensions dependency conflict by isolating Airflow's own environment from the pipeline's.

Hive Tables (HiveQL): Built an external text table over the raw CSV and a Parquet table partitioned by month, filled with a dynamic-partition INSERT OVERWRITE through Spark's Hive support; in CI 60,000 rows land in 20 partitions, MSCK REPAIR TABLE registers a partition written straight to storage, and a month filter prunes to one partition (3,015 rows).

Hadoop HDFS & MapReduce: Started a single-node HDFS (NameNode and DataNode) in CI, loaded the raw postings into it, and ran a Hadoop Streaming MapReduce job (Python mapper and reducer, 2 reducers) counting postings per month and source; its 100 counts match PySpark reading the same file from HDFS exactly.

projects.name: Job Search dbt Warehouse
bullets: A dbt dimensional model on a live Databricks SQL warehouse: staging views feeding dimension and fact tables, an incremental snapshot, and data tests CI runs against the warehouse on every push.

Dimensional Data Model: Built a dbt project (staging views into dimension and fact tables) on a live Databricks SQL warehouse, including a datediff-based days-to-decision measure and a row_number() window function for interview-round sequencing.

Data Quality Testing: Wrote 22 dbt tests (20 schema tests for uniqueness, not-null, referential integrity and accepted values, plus 2 business-rule tests: a decision date never precedes the applied date, and snapshot counts never go negative), run against the warehouse in CI.

Verified End-to-End: Ran dbt seed/run/test against a live Databricks warehouse (not just parsed) and spot-checked the resulting tables by hand; CI re-runs the same three commands against the same warehouse on every push using repository secrets.

projects.name: FinTech Credit Risk & Fraud Command Center
bullets: A credit-risk pipeline whose Random Forest reaches 93.4% precision on declined loans (0.92 ROC-AUC), with rule-based fraud flags and a FastAPI service answering in 67 ms median.

Low-Latency API Pipeline: Engineered an end-to-end credit risk evaluation pipeline using FastAPI and Python, achieving sub-100ms API response latency for real-time validation (67 ms median in the test suite).

Machine Learning Risk Classifier: Trained and benchmarked XGBoost against a Random Forest ensemble in Scikit-Learn to predict loan default probability, selecting Random Forest for production with 93.4% precision on declined applications (0.92 ROC-AUC on a held-out set), tracked in MLflow for experiment comparison.
Interactive Chart.js Dashboard: Developed SQLite schemas and transactional fraud anomaly checks with Chart.js dashboard integration to streamline credit approval cycles.

Real-Time Anomaly Flagging: Embedded velocity, amount-spike and foreign-location rules and scored them against labelled planted fraud; the velocity rule caught all 1,110 planted card-testing charges with no false alarms.
GraphQL API Layer: Added a Strawberry-GraphQL query layer alongside the existing REST endpoints, serving customer and loan data from the same database.

projects.name: TalentVenue EventIntel: Enterprise Data Platform & Predictive Intelligence
bullets: Bootcamp capstone on real business data across SQL Server, Azure ADLS Gen2, Snowflake and Streamlit, with a contract-cancellation model at 86.20% accuracy served as a Snowflake Python UDF.

ElevateMe Bootcamp Capstone: Built on the bootcamp's business data, connecting SQL Server, Azure ADLS Gen2, Snowflake, and Streamlit, accelerating financial queries by 45% and achieving 100% payment reconciliation accuracy.
Interactive Multi-Page Web UI: Built a multi-page web application using Python and Streamlit, delivering intuitive event data visualization components.

Predictive Contract Risk Model: Deployed a Random Forest model predicting contract cancellation risk with 86.20% accuracy (0.87 ROC-AUC), served via a Snowflake Python UDF for real-time inference directly from SQL.
Infrastructure as Code: Provisioned the production data warehouse -- Azure ADLS Gen2 storage, Snowflake database/schemas/warehouse, and the storage integration connecting them -- via Terraform.

Table Format Layer: Loaded staged extracts into Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg tables (native deltalake library and pyiceberg's SQL catalog) as a transactional consumption layer over the raw Parquet staging area.
Data Contract Validation: Built a TypeScript CLI (zod schema validation, Node's test runner) that verifies the ML pipeline's feature-mappings artifact before the dashboard relies on it for inference.

CI/CD Pipeline: Authored a Jenkins declarative pipeline (per-stage Docker agents) mirroring the existing GitHub Actions CI, verified against temporary Jenkins instance -- found and fixed two environment bugs (Docker socket group permissions, a missing system ODBC library) surfaced only by running it.

projects.name: AI Model Observability & Fairness Audits
bullets: Drift and fairness auditing for deployed models: KS and PSI drift tests, disparate-impact and equal-opportunity checks, and a published Tableau dashboard over 30,000 simulated inference records.
MLOps Drift Monitoring: Audits machine learning models in production by running Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) tests and Population Stability Index (PSI) to monitor feature drift (-35% silent drift).

Bias & Fairness Auditing: Evaluates disparate impact, demographic parity and Equal Opportunity (true-positive-rate gap) bias metrics, writing guardrail alerts to an audit table, in compliance with high-risk AI regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, US FTC).

Compliance Reporting: Deployed SQLite audit logging with automated compliance reporting, visualized in published interactive Tableau dashboard (public.tableau.com/app/profile/deshraj.jogiya/viz/AIModelObservabilityFairnessAuditDashboard) -- a live log-scale drift-trend chart plus subgroup fairness comparison over 30,000 simulated inference records.
Model Quality Guardrails: Implemented automated data validation checks that trigger alerts when input distributions diverge from training baselines.

Population Stability Index: Added a decile-binned PSI drift metric alongside the existing KS test, verified against audit data -- PSI stays under 0.05 on stable days and climbs past 0.25 exactly where the KS p-value collapses, tracking the same drift.

projects.name: Tax Anomaly Audit Compliance Engine
bullets: General-ledger audit pipeline where Benford's Law, an Isolation Forest and a tax-rate rule reach 97.8% precision and 95.7% recall; an auditor finds 90% of anomalies after 43 entries instead of 1,108.

General Ledger Audit Pipeline: Engineered an automated compliance audit pipeline in Python and SQL to ingest and validate general ledger transaction logs (-40% data preparation time; vectorised entry validation runs 99.9% faster than entry-by-entry checks on 100,000 entries), orchestrated as a Dagster asset graph.

Statistical & ML Anomaly Detection: Implemented Benford's Law distribution modeling and an unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly detection algorithm to flag high-risk transactions, adding a tax-rate rule layer for 97.8% precision and 95.7% recall, measured against a separate table of known injected anomalies.

Power BI Compliance Dashboard: Deployed interactive Power BI dashboards visualizing risk scores and transaction anomalies, accelerating audit review cycles by 25%; working in risk-priority order, an auditor finds 90% of anomalies after opening 43 entries instead of 1,108 (96% less review work).
Lineage & Audit Control: Enforced strict data lineage logging and schema validation rules across enterprise financial audit records.

projects.name: Multi-State Land Use Emissions Analysis
bullets: Land-use emissions ETL for 5 U.S. states built on the EPA's real state inventory: EPA-derived emission factors, a year-ahead forecast at 94.2% accuracy, shock detection and Census map layers.

Geospatial ETL Pipeline: Engineered a Python-based ETL pipeline processing daily land cover datasets across 5 U.S. states, saving 10 hours of manual preparation weekly (10.2 hours in the median week, counted from the pipeline's own work over 30 weeks).

Emissions Predictive Forecasting: Centralized data in SQLite database tracking land-use shifts and built regression forecasts (Random Forest/Linear Regression) achieving 90% accuracy (94.2% year-ahead on the EPA's 1990-2022 state land-use inventory).

ArcGIS Stakeholder Dashboards: Developed interactive ArcGIS Dashboards for regional stakeholder reporting, reducing anomaly detection times by 15% (the vectorised shock detector runs 52% faster with identical flags).

Geospatial Aggregations: Applied GeoPandas point-in-polygon spatial joins against U.S. Census state boundaries, checked state areas in an equal-area projection (EPSG:5070) and joined the EPA's state land-use inventory, which also sets each state's emission factors, before exporting GeoJSON layers for mapping.

projects.name: Real-Time IoT Telematics & Predictive Maintenance
bullets: EV battery and motor telemetry processed in micro-batches: Z-score detection catches 98.1% of planted sensor spikes at 90.5% precision, plus battery remaining-useful-life estimates.
High-Frequency Telemetry Ingestion: Engineered a streaming simulation pipeline in Python to ingest high-frequency EV battery and motor telemetry sensor logs in micro-batches.

Anomaly Detection & Device Health: Applied rolling statistical Z-score algorithms on sensor metrics to flag real-time anomalies and prevent device failures (98.1% recall, 90.5% precision against 214 planted sensor spikes).
Degradation & RUL Modeling: Implemented degradation modeling using exponential decay equations to estimate battery Remaining Useful Life (RUL) with Power BI dashboard tracking.
Automated Alert Triggering: Integrated real-time threshold monitoring to broadcast predictive maintenance alerts before component breakdown.
Jax-Accelerated Recurrence: Reimplemented the sequential health-decay/RUL calculation as a single JIT-compiled jax.lax.scan, verified numerically identical to the original per-row implementation.

projects.name: Sales Analytics & RFM Customer Segmentation Pipeline
bullets: A star-schema warehouse of 106,228 transactions where RFM scoring and K-Means find 4 customer personas explaining 93.9% of the variance, explored in a Power BI report.
Star Schema Database: Designed and implemented a SQL database with an optimized Star Schema modeling 106,228 customer transactions (2,000 customers over 2 years) for business intelligence reporting.
RFM & K-Means Clustering: Automated RFM scaling and unsupervised K-Means clustering in Python, identifying 4 customer personas that explain 93.9% of the variance in the scaled RFM features.

Executive Power BI Dashboard: Built interactive Power BI report with star-schema relationships and DAX measures over the pipeline live CSV exports -- including a K-Means cluster scatter plot and a persona slicer for marketing teams.
Pareto 80/20 Insights: Applied Pareto analysis showing the top 20% of customers generate 79.9% of revenue, isolating them for targeted retention campaigns.

projects.name: Extending STEM across ASL
bullets: Teaches 7 STEM concepts in ASL and recognises 29 STEM and computing word signs from video, 75.9% top-1 and 94.8% top-3 on held-out WLASL clips, live from a webcam.

Deep Learning Web Application: Pioneered an inclusive Python web platform leveraging TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Flask, making 7 STEM concepts accessible to ASL users and recognising 29 STEM and computing word signs from video.

Gesture Recognition Algorithm: Implemented a sign recognition algorithm leveraging CNN models and contour geometry, cutting gesture redundancy and boosting learning efficiency by 30% (MediaPipe hand landmarks, OpenCV contour features and a PyTorch GRU reach 75.9% top-1 and 94.8% top-3 on held-out WLASL clips; the 29 signs share 18 hand shapes, 38% fewer to practise).
User Feedback & Evaluation: Synthesized feedback from 50+ STEM students, achieving a user satisfaction score of 4.6/5 based on post-lesson survey evaluations.

Real-Time Video Frame Processing: Optimized OpenCV frame capture and pre-processing steps for low-latency web browser sign gesture classification (a two-second webcam recording is recognised in about 1.1 s on a laptop CPU).

projects.name: Member Messages QA System: Semantic Search & NER-Based Question Answering
bullets: Answers natural-language questions about members from their messages: on 26 labelled questions it finds the right member 100% of the time and the right answer 96%.

Semantic Search QA Engine: Built an interactive /ask API answering natural-language questions about member data, ranking unstructured messages by cosine similarity over SentenceTransformer (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) embeddings.

Named Entity Recognition: Integrated spaCy NER with fuzzy first-name matching to identify a question's subject before ranking relevant messages; on 26 labelled paraphrased questions it finds the right member 100% of the time and the right answer 96%.

Dynamic Information Extraction: Implemented regex-based extraction for contact info, numeric quantities, and companion/group references from unstructured message text, with fallback to the closest-matching message when no structured answer applies.

Architecture Tradeoff Analysis: Evaluated and documented five candidate approaches (rule-based matching, knowledge graphs, fine-tuned LLMs, hybrid retrieval) before selecting embeddings-based semantic search for its balance of speed, accuracy, and maintainability.
LlamaIndex Retrieval Path: Built an alternative semantic-search retriever using LlamaIndex's VectorStoreIndex over the same embedding model, verified against the message dataset.
Semantic Kernel Orchestration: Wrapped the NER/ranking/extraction functions as native Semantic Kernel plugin functions, orchestrated through Kernel instance.

RAG Pipeline: Built retrieve-then-generate RAG chain with LangChain, generating natural-language answers grounded in retrieved messages via a local model -- verified with both fast deterministic wiring tests and end-to-end generation test.

projects.name: Sentence Transformers, Multi-Task Learning & LLM Fine-Tuning
bullets: A Small BERT sentence transformer extended into a multi-task model, plus LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-0.5B on Dolly-15k with a declining loss curve over 3 epochs.

Sentence Transformer Architecture: Built a Sentence Transformer using a Small BERT model from TensorFlow Hub, encoding sentences into 128-dimensional contextual embeddings via mean pooling across token representations.

Multi-Task Learning Expansion: Extended the shared transformer backbone with two task-specific heads (3-class sentence classification, 2-class sentiment classification), each with its own softmax output layer.

Transfer Learning Strategy: Evaluated freezing strategies (full model vs. backbone-only vs. single task head) and proposed a staged fine-tuning approach -- freeze lower layers, fine-tune top layers and task heads.
Training Loop Simulation: Simulated multi-task training with synthetic text and one-hot encoded labels via model.fit(), logging per-task loss and accuracy to validate the architecture end-to-end.

LoRA Fine-Tuning: LoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on Databricks Dolly-15k subset (free Colab T4 GPU), with declining loss curve over 3 epochs and an honest before/after comparison on held-out prompts.

projects.name: CurioSync: Fact-Checked LinkedIn Publishing Pipeline

Fact-Checked LLM Drafting: Gemini drafts posts only from the live portfolio profile; mechanical checks reject any number or tool not in the facts, 'we' on solo work and undisclosed simulated data, and a second model pass flags invented claims before anything is published.
LLM & Image Generation: Integrated Gemini LLM chains and developed custom Pillow image-processing engines to automatically render branding graphics (+150% engagement).
Credential-Safe Control Panel: Jinja2/HTMX control panel with Fernet symmetric encryption protecting stored LinkedIn credentials.

projects.name: Solid Object Detection & Identification
bullets: A PyTorch CNN that classifies 7 shape classes at 99.2% on 2,000 held-out images, with OpenCV contour geometry as an independent check, served on AWS Lambda through ONNX.
Computer Vision & Geometry Pipeline: Developed a shape detection and identification pipeline using PyTorch, OpenCV, and custom CNN models.

High Classification Accuracy: Achieved 99.2% classification accuracy on 2,000 held-out images from 10,000 generated shape images across 7 classes (checked in CI); contour geometry independently confirms the CNN on 66% of images, and those confirmed predictions are 99.9% correct.

Visualization Enhancements: Implemented visual bounding boxes and shape classification overlays, increasing visualization capabilities by 33% (four overlays, up from three: box, label, confidence and the located outline coloured by contour-geometry agreement).

Contour Analysis & Preprocessing: Applied Gaussian blurring and Canny edge detection in OpenCV to extract robust shape boundary features prior to neural network classification (Canny-located boxes reach a mean IoU of 0.93 against 0.82 for a thresholded mask).

Real-Time Serverless Inference: Deployed the trained model as a live AWS Lambda function triggered by S3 image uploads -- exported to ONNX (~615KB) so it ships as a plain Lambda zip via onnxruntime, avoiding a PyTorch container image and its ECR storage cost. Verified end-to-end with live S3-to-Lambda integration test running in CI against the deployed AWS infrastructure.

projects.name: Clinical Trials Patient Outcomes Analysis
bullets: Survival analysis across 3 cohorts with Kaplan-Meier curves, pairwise log-rank tests and de-identified patient data; the full report refreshes 60% faster.

Biostatistical Survival Modeling: Conducted survival analysis using Kaplan-Meier curves and computed pairwise log-rank tests (lifelines) and a chi-square adverse-event test (SciPy) to evaluate treatment efficacy across 3 cohorts.

Tableau Research Reporting: Authored Tableau reports showcasing patient outcomes and statistical significance, improving decision reporting speed for researchers by 30%; a one-process refresh rebuilds the full report 60% faster (6.3 s instead of 15.5 s).
HIPAA Data Anonymization: Enforced data privacy transformations to mask patient personal identifiable information (PII) across analytical schemas.

Non-Blocking Ingestion API: Built a Spring WebFlux REST endpoint that persists incoming job-posting events via R2DBC without blocking a thread per request.

Minimal API: Built ASP.NET Core minimal API (C#) for browsing/adding interview questions, backed by Entity Framework Core + SQLite.

cases.title: Data Engineer
cases.posting:
About the role
You will build and run the batch pipelines behind our analytics platform.

Requirements
- 2+ years building data pipelines in Python and SQL
- Spark or Flink for large batch jobs
- Orchestration with Airflow, Dagster or a similar tool
- Experience with one of Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift
- Data modeling for analytics and dbt
- Docker and CI/CD
- 4+ years with Cassandra or DynamoDB
